instruction: Add underline formatting to all italicized text while keeping the italic style

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires underlining all italic text. Document has 21 italic runs without underline. Evaluator checks all italic runs have underline=True.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies that all italic text has underline formatting
Postconfig appropriately saves the document before verification
Data flow is correct: save file -> fetch from VM -> parse .docx -> check formatting
Metric logic properly iterates through all runs and checks italic+underline combination
Expected parameter handling is correct (empty rules dict, not accessed inappropriately)

Minor issue: run.italic check may miss italic text that inherits formatting from styles (where run.italic=None). In python-docx, run.italic can be True/False/None, and None means inherit from style. The check 'if run.italic:' only catches explicitly set italic=True
Instruction says 'while keeping the italic style' - this is implicitly verified since the check only examines runs where italic is still True
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking 'if run.italic or (run.italic is None and run has inherited italic from style)' to handle style-inherited italic formatting. However, this may be a non-issue if LibreOffice Writer always sets run.italic explicitly rather than using None for inherited styles
Could add explicit check that italic style is still present, though the current logic implicitly verifies this
